appraisal_events.evidence: Saint-Loup souffrit horriblement de cette brouille ... il ne savait rien, sa maîtresse gardait un silence qui finit par affoler sa douleur jusqu'à lui faire se demander si elle n'était pas cachée à Doncières ou partie pour les Indes.
appraisal_events.explanation: After a quarrel with his mistress, Saint-Loup passes from a brief, illusory calm into mounting, obsessive anxiety over her silence, ending in near-frantic uncertainty about her whereabouts — a clear loss of emotional composure and control.

status_effects.explanation: Saint-Loup is shown dependent on and destabilized by his mistress's silence, losing emotional command as his suffering escalates into frantic doubt.
